source.title: Provenance attestations
source.applicability: Implementation guidance for generating SLSA-compliant build provenance including source code references, build parameters, and artifact verification. Covers technical requirements for build traceability and reproducibility.

originalText:
# Provenance attestations


The provenance attestations include facts about the build process, including
details such as:

- Build timestamps
- Build parameters and environment
- Version control metadata
- Source code details
- Materials (files, scripts) consumed during the build

By default, provenance attestations follow the
[SLSA provenance schema, version 0.2](https://slsa.dev/spec/v0.2/provenance#schema).
You can optionally enable [SLSA Provenance v1](https://slsa.dev/spec/v1.1/provenance#schema)
using [the `version` parameter](#version).

For more information about how BuildKit populates these provenance properties, refer to
[SLSA definitions](/build/metadata/attestations/slsa-provenance/slsa-definitions/).
